title: Setup › Approval Requests list shows the stored flow and step labels under zh-CN: the data-door read of sys_approval_request skips the reader-locale labels the approvals door applies
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#5` (seat post #26945, `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C`) from the os-dev report on #26883 (card comment 6459234604, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

Seam: `sys_approval_request` read through the generic data door → `plugin-approvals` `reader-locale-labels.ts` (`localizeRequestLabels`), applied today only on the approvals door.

## Measured (card thread, on `origin/main` `7eb613c3`)

- #26883 reports two screens under zh-CN on 18.2.0 (HotCRM pass, `52-zh-09-setup-approval-requests.png`, `53-zh-mgr-01-approvals-inbox.png`): the approvals inbox and Setup › 审批申请 both read "Large Deal Approval" / "Sales Manager Review" although the app's zh-CN pack translates them.
- The inbox half is fixed in the console by PR #27040: the inbox read the approvals door with a bare `fetch`, so the door picked labels by the browser's language. The approvals door (`GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` and `:id`) already localizes `process_label`, `step_label` and `object_label` by `Accept-Language` (`reader-locale-labels.ts`, since 18.1.0).
- The Setup list (`sys_approval_request` object list, view `all_requests`) reads the generic data door, which serves the stored `process_label` / `current_step_label`. No console change reaches it.

## Wanted

The `sys_approval_request` list in Setup shows the flow, step and object labels in the reader's language, through the same `localizeRequestLabels` lookup the approvals door uses (stored text when the pack has no entry). Landing: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` (apply it on the data-door read of `sys_approval_request`), not `plugin-list` / `plugin-grid`.

Related: #26883 (the inbox half, PR #27040).

Dedupe: open-issue titles naming approvals + label/locale/zh: 1 hit, #26883 itself. Dedupe words: approval request list view flow label zh-CN, sys_approval_request process_label data door locale, Setup approval requests translated labels.
